title: Rewriting the map: clearer docs and a cleaner homepage
summary:
A day of spring cleaning: we stripped the marketing fluff from our docs, clarified the homepage, and made ElevenLabs text-to-speech cheaper.

We stripped the marketing fluff out of the FAQ and reworked the homepage copy. The focus is now squarely on what matters: how the platform works, developer earnings, and a clear split between what just shipped and what is coming next.

We aligned our ElevenLabs integration with their Scale plan, which means generating high-quality text-to-speech just got noticeably cheaper for everyone.

highlights.title: Public Roadmap
highlights.text: The homepage now clearly splits what just shipped from what's coming next, plus better visibility for developer earnings. [View site](https://hello.pollinations.ai)

highlights.title: Docs Cleanup
highlights.text: We stripped the marketing fluff out of the Pollen FAQ. Just straight answers about wallets and tiers now.

highlights.title: Pollen Packs
highlights.text: Updated the Pollen pack tier structures and fixed some Stripe checkout metadata. Buying credits is now slightly more robust.

highlights.title: Cheaper Audio
highlights.text: ElevenLabs text-to-speech is now cheaper to generate. Scribe has moved to the paid tier because servers aren't free. [View API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs)

highlights.title: Community Polish
highlights.text: Trimmed the copy on the community page and unstyled some links. Less reading, more building. [Join Discord](https://chat.pollinations.ai)
